title: Product settings
description: Product behavior settings stored in Product.settings.

kitchenPrinterEnable.title: Print ticket
kitchenPrinterEnable.description: When enabled, this product participates in receipt printing.

kitchenTicketDisabled.title: Kitchen ticket disabled
kitchenTicketDisabled.description: When enabled, this product is omitted from the kitchen ticket. Unset or false prints normally.
